question: Calculate the percentage change in the total number of unsheltered homeless people from 2015 to 2018 for each state by summing the counts over all Continuums of Care (CoCs) within each state. Then, determine the national average of these state percentage changes. Identify the five states whose percentage change is closest to this national average percentage change. Please provide the state abbreviations.
sql:
WITH state_2015 AS (
  SELECT SUBSTR(CoC_Number, 1, 2) as state_abbr, SUM(Unsheltered_Homeless) as total_unsheltered
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_hud_pit_homelessness.hud_pit_by_coc`
  WHERE Count_Year = 2015
  GROUP BY state_abbr
),
state_2018 AS (
  SELECT SUBSTR(CoC_Number, 1, 2) as state_abbr, SUM(Unsheltered_Homeless) as total_unsheltered
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_hud_pit_homelessness.hud_pit_by_coc`
  WHERE Count_Year = 2018
  GROUP BY state_abbr
),
state_changes AS (
  SELECT 
    s2015.state_abbr,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(s2018.total_unsheltered - s2015.total_unsheltered, s2015.total_unsheltered) * 100 as pct_change
  FROM state_2015 s2015
  JOIN state_2018 s2018 ON s2015.state_abbr = s2018.state_abbr
),
national_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(pct_change) as avg_pct FROM state_changes
),
state_changes_with_diff AS (
  SELECT 
    sc.state_abbr,
    sc.pct_change,
    na.avg_pct,
    ABS(sc.pct_change - na.avg_pct) as diff_from_avg
  FROM state_changes sc
  CROSS JOIN national_avg na
)
SELECT state_abbr
FROM state_changes_with_diff
ORDER BY diff_from_avg ASC
LIMIT 5
